notes: Five-way plaza at Hamilton / Hoffner / Spring Grove / Dodsworth (about x1100-1900, y2400-3120). Spring Grove is 90' (printed) at the plaza mouth and 60' further south; its NE leg (60') is printed only 'AV.' on this sheet, named Spring Grove from the key map (it runs NE through 624 to the SPRING GROVE label on 626). Modelled as: Hoffner ends at Hamilton; Hamilton runs on to meet Spring Grove's south-leg centreline (the 90'/60' leg, whose water pipe runs down its middle) at the plaza mouth; Dodsworth meets the NE-leg centreline (centre taken between the lot fronts, the NE-leg pipe is off-centre). The two Spring Grove legs are offset ~25 ft (90' leg widened on the west side), so the street jogs between those two nodes. Hoffner, Cooper and Dorman are printed bare (no suffix). Unnamed alleys between Hamilton and Spring Grove: an E-W alley (25' west part, 20' east part) and a 25' N-S alley running north from it to where the drawing stops (y~733). Circled numbers (59', 56', 57', 55', 40') are grade elevations, not widths.
